text: Add the missing base .radar-clock-time rule and the font-size/weight on .landing-brand (line 47 is its gap declaration).
command: cd /work/apps/canvas/src && sed -i '70a .radar-clock-time { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--radar-ink); }' ops/radar.css && sed -i '47s/gap: 10px;/gap: 10px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600;/' styles/landing.css && sed -n 69,73p ops/radar.css | cut -c1-140 && sed -n 44,52p styles/landing.css
